items.title: File Einspruch against Kfz-Steuerbescheid
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 27.12.2024, sent by post. Per §122(2) AO the notice counts as delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the third day after posting, unless it actually arrived later (none indicated). 27.12.2024 + 3 days = 30.12.2024, which is a Monday (not a weekend/holiday in NW), so Bekanntgabe = 30.12.2024. The one-month Einspruchsfrist begins the following day (§108 AO, §187(1) BGB) and, per §188(2) BGB, ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event (the Bekanntgabe day), i.e. 30.01.2025. 30.01.2025 is a Thursday, not a public holiday in NW, so the deadline stands.

items.title: Annual Kraftfahrzeugsteuer collected by direct debit
items.quote: Die Steuer wird jährlich im Voraus durch Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: The letter states the annual tax of 186,00 € is collected in advance each year via SEPA direct debit ('Lastschrift'), but no specific calendar date for the debit is given anywhere in the text, so the exact due date of the first/next collection cannot be determined from this letter alone.

warnings: No specific date for the direct-debit collection of the 186,00 € annual tax is stated in the letter, so the exact payment/collection date could not be determined; check your bank statements or contact the Hauptzollamt to confirm the collection date.

Verify the printed IBAN (DE03 2900 0000 0029 0010 20) independently via an official Zoll channel before relying on it, since this is only a direct-debit collection account reference and should not be used to send any payment yourself.
